sloka: गुरु पुत्रान् अहम् सर्वान् नमस् कृत्य प्रसादये ।शिरसा प्रणतो याचे ब्राह्मणान् तपसि स्थितान् ॥१-५७-१९॥
transliteration: guru putrān aham sarvān namas kṛtya prasādaye ।śirasā praṇato yāce brāhmaṇān tapasi sthitān ॥1-57-19॥

translations.english: O Gentle sage I have never told a lie in spite of troubled circumstances, I shall never dabble in falsehood. I swear upon it by kshatriya morality .
